description: This file is a Python source code defining pytest plugin configuration for the Twister harness, including command-line options, configuration validation, and path normalization.

methods.name: pytest_addoption
methods.description: Adds command-line options and ini options for the Twister harness plugin to the pytest parser.

methods.name: pytest_configure
methods.description: Configures pytest with Twister harness settings, validates options, and normalizes paths.

methods.name: _validate_options
methods.description: Validates that required options like build directory and device type are provided and valid.

methods.name: _normalize_paths
methods.description: Normalizes user-provided paths for build directory and scripts.

methods.name: _normalize_path
methods.description: Expands environment variables and user home in paths, then normalizes to absolute path.
